metadata.description: Skills, agents, and commands for AI coding agents - individually selectable

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Use when the user asks to run Codex CLI (codex exec, codex resume) or references OpenAI Codex for code analysis, refactoring, or automated editing. Uses GPT-5.2 by default for state-of-the-art software engineering.

plugins.name: gemini
plugins.description: Run the Gemini CLI headless as a second-opinion reviewer for code, architecture or plan reviews and big-context analysis, then verify its claims. Use when asked to run Gemini or for a cross-model review.

plugins.name: perplexity
plugins.description: Web search and research using Perplexity AI. Use when user says 'search', 'find', 'look up', 'ask', 'research', or 'what's the latest' for generic queries.

plugins.name: agent-md-refactor
plugins.description: Refactor bloated AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or similar agent instruction files to follow progressive disclosure principles. Splits monolithic files into organized, linked documentation.

plugins.name: command-creator
plugins.description: Create or update Claude Code slash-command files (.claude/commands/*.md): frontmatter, $ARGUMENTS placeholders, pre-run context, approval gates and stop rules. Use for a reusable /command for a recurring workflow.

plugins.name: plugin-forge
plugins.description: Create and manage Claude Code marketplace plugins: scaffold directories, edit plugin.json and marketplace.json, add components, bump versions and test or publish. Use for plugin packaging and install problems.

plugins.name: skill-judge
plugins.description: Evaluate Agent Skill design quality against official specifications and best practices. Use when reviewing, auditing, or improving SKILL.md files and skill packages.

plugins.name: skill-updater
plugins.description: Check whether a skill, command or agent in this repo is still current against its upstream sources and the models it targets, and record the result with audit.py track. Use to detect drift or stale content.

plugins.name: backend-to-frontend-handoff-docs
plugins.description: Create API handoff documentation for frontend developers. Use when backend work is complete and needs to be documented for frontend integration.

plugins.name: c4-architecture
plugins.description: Generate C4 model Mermaid diagrams (context, container, component, dynamic, deployment) from a description or repository evidence such as docker-compose and Kubernetes manifests. Use to map or document a software system.

plugins.name: crafting-effective-readmes
plugins.description: Write, update or audit README.md files so each reader reaches a supported first success, with install commands, versions, badges and links checked against the repository. Use for new or stale READMEs.

plugins.name: pr-diagrams
plugins.description: Render draw.io diagrams to embedded PNGs, attach them to a pull request with gh --attach, find promotion source PRs, and reuse their reviewers. Use for PR diagram upload, promotion reuse, related merged PRs, and reviewer reuse.

plugins.name: draw-io
plugins.description: Create and edit uncompressed draw.io (.drawio) diagrams and export them to editable PNGs. Use for draw.io files, AWS architecture diagrams, connector layout fixes and diagram figures for slides.

plugins.name: excalidraw
plugins.description: Create, inspect, edit and compare Excalidraw diagrams through a bundled script that keeps scene JSON out of context: label summaries, boxes and arrows, validation and diffs. Use when the user names an Excalidraw file.

plugins.name: frontend-to-backend-requirements
plugins.description: Document frontend data needs for backend developers. Use when frontend needs to communicate API requirements to backend.

plugins.name: marp-slide
plugins.description: Create or redesign Marp Markdown slide decks from bundled styles with embedded CSS, Marpit image layouts and a render-and-fix check. Use for slides, presentations or improving a crowded deck.

plugins.name: mermaid-diagrams
plugins.description: Create, edit and repair Mermaid diagrams (.mmd or ```mermaid blocks): sequence, class, ER, state, C4, Gantt, Git graphs and more. Use to diagram or visualize something, or when a diagram fails to render.

plugins.name: writing-clearly-and-concisely
plugins.description: Draft or copyedit English prose for clarity and concision in READMEs, docs, commit messages, error messages and UI copy, keeping conditions, quotations and identifiers intact. Use to tighten or clarify text.

plugins.name: design-system-starter
plugins.description: Set up or evolve a shared design system: semantic design tokens (DTCG, CSS variables), light/dark themes, component APIs and versioned migration off scattered styles. Use when UI is inconsistent across screens or apps.

plugins.name: mui
plugins.description: Material-UI v7 component library patterns including sx prop styling, theme integration, responsive design, and MUI-specific hooks.

plugins.name: ui-ux-principles
plugins.description: Apply eight pass/fail UI/UX rules (loading, responsive, hierarchy, tokens, consistency, accessibility, states, interaction) when building or reviewing a screen, returning a rule/verdict/evidence/fix table.

plugins.name: openapi-to-typescript
plugins.description: Convert OpenAPI 3.0.x specs into TypeScript types for schemas and each operation's parameters, request body and responses, plus runtime type guards. Swagger 2.0 and 3.1 are detected and refused.

plugins.name: react-dev
plugins.description: Type React 18 and 19 code in TypeScript: props, refs, event handlers, generic components, React 19 Actions, Server Components and router typing. Use for .tsx work and React or router upgrades.

plugins.name: react-useeffect
plugins.description: Decide whether React logic belongs in render, an event handler, a key reset or useEffect, and fix misbehaving Effects: dependencies, cleanup, stale fetches and Strict Mode double runs. Use when writing or reviewing useEffect code.

plugins.name: database-schema-designer
plugins.description: Design and review SQL and MongoDB schemas: keys, constraints, multi-tenancy, soft deletes, indexes and staged live migrations for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite. Use for a data model, DDL, schema review or migration plan.

plugins.name: dependency-updater
plugins.description: Smart dependency management for any language. Auto-detects project type, applies safe updates automatically, prompts for major versions.

plugins.name: naming-analyzer
plugins.description: Review code identifiers and suggest clearer names backed by the implementation and call sites, with confidence and compatibility risk per rename. Returns a rename table and edits nothing.

plugins.name: reducing-entropy
plugins.description: Deletion-biased codebase minimization: inventory code to delete or merge, guard behavior and public APIs, and measure line counts before and after. Use only when explicitly asked to reduce entropy or shrink a codebase.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Create, validate and resume project-session handoff documents in .claude/handoffs/ with secret checks and staleness reports. Use to pause coding, transfer work to another agent or resume a handoff.

plugins.name: lesson-learned
plugins.description: Turn recent commits, a branch diff, a specific commit or staged changes into one engineering lesson grounded in concrete changes, with a next-time action. Use when asked what you learned.

plugins.name: game-changing-features
plugins.description: Find and rank high-leverage product opportunities from repository, feedback and usage evidence, saved as a session file. Use when asking what to build next or how to fix retention.

plugins.name: gepetto
plugins.description: Creates detailed, sectionized implementation plans through research, stakeholder interviews, and multi-LLM review. Use when planning features that need thorough pre-implementation analysis.

plugins.name: requirements-clarity
plugins.description: Clarify vague feature requests into a scoped PRD with testable acceptance criteria through short scored question rounds. Use when a request lacks scope or success criteria.

plugins.name: ship-learn-next
plugins.description: Turn articles, tutorials, talks or course notes into a Ship-Learn-Next plan with a shippable first rep, completion criteria and next reps, or review a reported rep to choose the next. Use for "make this actionable".

plugins.name: difficult-workplace-conversations
plugins.description: Prepare, rehearse and follow up on high-stakes workplace conversations such as raise requests, bad news, layoffs, disputes or sensitive concerns. Use when the outcome is negotiated or emotions may derail it.

plugins.name: feedback-mastery
plugins.description: Prepare, deliver, receive and follow up on specific workplace feedback using Situation-Behavior-Impact, and reset stakeholder expectations on scope or dates. Use for recognition, behavior feedback, vague criticism or deadline pushback.

plugins.name: daily-meeting-update
plugins.description: Generate concise Markdown daily standup or scrum updates covering yesterday, today, blockers and discussion topics. Interviews only for missing facts. Use when preparing for a daily team sync.

plugins.name: professional-communication
plugins.description: Guide technical communication for software developers. Covers email structure, team messaging etiquette, meeting agendas, and adapting messages for technical vs non-technical audiences.

plugins.name: qa-test-planner
plugins.description: Create manual QA test plans, test cases, regression and smoke suites, release-gate decisions, Figma validation checklists and bug reports. Use only when invoked by name or /qa-test-planner.

plugins.name: commit-work
plugins.description: Stage and commit Git changes so each commit holds only the approved change, leaving already-staged content untouched, splitting mixed hunks and writing Conventional Commits messages. Use to commit or stage selected work.

plugins.name: datadog-cli
plugins.description: Datadog CLI for searching logs, querying metrics, tracing requests, and managing dashboards. Use when debugging production issues or working with Datadog observability.

plugins.name: domain-name-brainstormer
plugins.description: Brainstorm, screen and rank brandable domain names across TLDs for apps, products and companies, and report registration status honestly via RDAP/WHOIS. Use when naming or rebranding a project.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Edit existing drafts to remove formulaic AI-like prose, hype, vague attributions and repetitive patterns while preserving facts, quotations and author voice. Use when a draft sounds robotic or salesy.

plugins.name: meme-factory
plugins.description: Build memegen.link meme URLs with real template IDs, escaped captions, layout options or a custom background, and write text-only memes. Use when asked for a meme or reaction image.

plugins.name: web-to-markdown
plugins.description: Converts webpage URLs to clean Markdown by calling the local web2md CLI (Puppeteer + Readability), suitable for JS-rendered pages.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Work with live Jira issues through the jira CLI, Atlassian MCP or REST: view, search with JQL, create, edit, comment, transition, link and set epic, sprint and assignee. Use to act on a ticket or query Jira.

plugins.name: agent-ascii-ui-mockup-generator
plugins.description: Create ASCII UI wireframes with distinct layout alternatives, rationales and a component handoff. Use to explore dashboard, form, navigation or TUI layouts before implementation.

plugins.name: agent-codebase-pattern-finder
plugins.description: Read-only search delegate that finds similar implementations and usage examples in the codebase, returned as verbatim snippets with file:line citations. Use before writing code that should match house conventions.

plugins.name: agent-communication-excellence-coach
plugins.description: Review professional or technical communication drafts for clarity, tone, audience fit and risk, with suggested edits and difficult-conversation practice. Use before sending an email or Slack message or giving feedback.

plugins.name: agent-general-purpose
plugins.description: Coordinate multi-file, multi-component programming work end to end: break it down, delegate or implement, integrate and run verification gates. Use for complex debugging, implementation or refactoring across several files.

plugins.name: agent-mermaid-diagram-specialist
plugins.description: Delegate creating, repairing or restyling Mermaid diagrams (flowchart, sequence, ERD, class, state, C4, gantt) in a separate context. Returns fenced mermaid blocks with the chosen type and validation status.

plugins.name: agent-ui-ux-designer
plugins.description: Honest, research-backed critique of a UI, screen, mockup, user flow or design decision in its own context. Returns a verdict, ranked findings with evidence and fixes, and the single biggest win.

plugins.name: command-codex-plan
plugins.description: Prepare prompt_to_codex.md so you can run Codex yourself and get an implementation plan in codex-plan.md. Gathers repo context and shows the manual `codex exec` command; never runs Codex.

plugins.name: command-compose-email
plugins.description: Draft or rewrite a professional email to a peer, stakeholder, manager or leadership using What-Why-How. Produces a subject and body to paste; never sends.

plugins.name: command-explain-changes-mental-model
plugins.description: Explain a git diff, commit, branch, range, PR or pasted patch as dependency-ordered logical groups with file references and a review sequence. Use to understand or onboard onto a changeset.

plugins.name: command-explain-pr-changes
plugins.description: Create or update the GitHub pull request for the current branch from its committed diff: summary, changeset triage, optional diagram, promotion-branch bodies and reviewers. Pushes feature branches and writes PRs.

plugins.name: command-sync-branch
plugins.description: Rebase the current feature branch onto the latest origin/main (or a given target) and update its PR with --force-with-lease. Use when a branch or PR is behind or conflicts with its base.

plugins.name: command-sync-skills-readme
plugins.description: Regenerate the "Available Skills" table in the root README.md from each skills/*/SKILL.md name and description. Use after adding, removing, renaming or re-describing a skill.

plugins.name: command-viral-tweet
plugins.description: Rewrite a tweet idea or draft into three X (Twitter) post variants with engagement trade-offs, character counts and a recommendation. Drafting only; never publishes or schedules.
